Name: Weekly Break Reminder
Author: treehat
Description:
Displays a simple reminder to take a break after a number of days have passed in-game since the save file was loaded. The reminder is displayed as a dialogue box, so the game will remain paused until you are ready to come back to it. The frequency of these breaks can also be changed, if you need to take breaks more (or less) frequently; see the [i]Configuration [/i]section below.

If you continue playing without exiting, the message will continue to display again once every 7 days (or whatever interval you have specified).

Note: When joining a multiplayer game, it will start counting days from when you join the game, [i]not [/i]when the host starts.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration
[/size]There are some options that can be configured in the configuration file, located at [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/WeeklyBreakReminder/config.json[/font]:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ShowStartupNotice[/font]: Shows a notification when you load a save of how frequently the breaks will occur. (Off by default.)
[*][font=Courier New]DaysBetweenBreaks[/font]: Change the number of days that pass in-game before break reminders happen to be more or less than seven days.
[*][font=Courier New]CompactMessages[/font]: Makes the reminder messages take up less screen space. (Off by default.)
[/list]
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ installed, you can set these from the in-game menu.[list]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]
